faq.pageSubtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? Send us a message via the contact page.
faq.q1: Can I book a massage now?
faq.a1: Not yet. Alvessa is first building a network of professional massage therapists in Utrecht. Customer bookings open only when real, vetted therapists are ready.

faq.a3: Go to For therapists, fill in the application form, and we will contact you for an introduction. After approval you set up your profile, services and availability — public bookings follow later.

faq.a7: Email us at hello@alvessa.nl. We're happy to help — whether you are a therapist or an interested customer.

about.metaDescription: Alvessa is building a network of professional massage therapists in Utrecht. Customer bookings are not open yet.
about.missionBody: Alvessa makes booking trusted home services simple — starting with professional massage in Utrecht. We believe in quality over speed: first a strong network of independent therapists, then we open for customers.
about.storyBody:
Alvessa was born from a simple idea: booking a reliable professional at home should be as easy as ordering a taxi. No endless searching, no vague arrangements.

We are starting with home massage in Utrecht. Right now we are recruiting the first founding massage therapists. Customer bookings are not open yet — we open only when the network is truly ready.
about.value1Desc: We'd rather onboard fewer therapists who are genuinely excellent than offer a large pool with inconsistent quality.
about.value2Desc: No hidden fees. When bookings are open, the price you see is the price you pay.
about.value3Desc: We launch customer bookings only when vetted therapists are ready — no empty claims about available masseurs today.

privacy.metaDescription: Read Alvessa's privacy policy. We process your data carefully and in compliance with GDPR.
privacy.s1Body: Alvessa is an online platform connecting customers with independent home service providers. We are currently building a network of massage therapists in Utrecht; customer bookings are not open yet. Alvessa is the data controller for the personal data described in this policy.
privacy.s2Body: We process: name and email address (on registration), address details (for in-home appointments), payment information (processed via Stripe — we do not store full payment card details), and booking history.
privacy.s3Title: 3. Why do we process your data?
privacy.s3Body: Your data is processed for the performance of the contract (booking), compliance with legal obligations (including 7-year financial record-keeping), and service improvement. We do not process data for marketing without your consent.
privacy.s4Title: 4. How long do we retain your data?
privacy.s4Body: Account data is retained while your account is active. Booking and payment data is retained for at least 7 years as required by Dutch tax law. You can delete your account at any time via hello@alvessa.nl.
privacy.s5Body: We use Supabase (database hosting) and Stripe (payment processing, PCI-DSS certified) as processors. Where data is processed outside the EEA, we do so with appropriate safeguards. We have data processing agreements with all processors.
privacy.s6Body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection. Contact us at info@alvessa.nl. You can also lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl).
privacy.s7Body: Questions about this privacy policy? Email info@alvessa.nl.

terms.metaDescription: Read Alvessa's terms of service. Applicable to all bookings and use of the platform.
terms.s1Body: Alvessa: the platform connecting supply and demand for in-home services (current focus: home massage in Utrecht; customer bookings are not open yet). Customer: the person booking a service via Alvessa. Provider: the independent professional offering services through Alvessa. Booking: the in-home service booked via the platform.
terms.s2Body: These terms apply to all use of the Alvessa platform and all agreements concluded through the platform.
terms.s3Body: A booking is confirmed after successful payment via Stripe. The customer pays the full amount upfront. Alvessa retains a platform fee from the amount paid out to the provider.
terms.s4Body: Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before the appointment. Cancellations within 24 hours may incur a fee of 50% of the booking price. Refunds are processed via the original payment method.
terms.s5Body: The provider performs the service carefully and professionally and is responsible for meeting the legal requirements that apply to offering services independently. The provider acts as an independent contractor and is not an employee of Alvessa.
terms.s6Body: Alvessa is an intermediary platform and is not liable for damages arising from the performance of the service itself. The provider bears their own responsibility for this. Alvessa's liability for direct damages is limited to the amount of the relevant booking.
terms.s7Body: These terms are governed by Dutch law. Disputes shall be submitted to the competent Dutch court.

seoDeepTissue.h1: Deep Tissue Massage at Home in Utrecht — Coming Soon
seoDeepTissue.intro: Deep tissue massage targets deeper muscle layers and connective tissue. Alvessa is building this offering in Utrecht. Customer bookings are not open yet — massage therapists can apply now.
seoDeepTissue.whatBody: In deep tissue massage, the therapist works with slow, deep movements on the muscle layers beneath the surface. It is more intensive than classic relaxation massage and aimed at chronic tension and adhesions.
seoDeepTissue.benefitsTitle: When is deep tissue massage suitable?
seoDeepTissue.benefit1: Persistent back or neck muscle tension
seoDeepTissue.benefit2: Persistent muscle tension from prolonged sitting or heavy work
seoDeepTissue.benefit3: Muscle recovery after intensive activity (consult a doctor first for medical conditions)
seoDeepTissue.benefit4: Muscle pain that does not respond to standard massage techniques
seoDeepTissue.noteBody: Deep tissue massage can feel more intense than relaxation massage. Once bookings open, always communicate with the therapist about pressure and comfort.
seoDeepTissue.areasBody: We are focusing deep tissue massage first on Utrecht Centrum, Oost, Leidsche Rijn and surrounding areas — when customer bookings open.
seoDeepTissue.faq1A: Deep tissue massage can be more intense than relaxation massage, but should never be unpleasantly painful. You can always ask the therapist to adjust the pressure.
seoDeepTissue.faq2Q: How long will the massage last later?
seoDeepTissue.faq2A: For a full treatment we often recommend 90 minutes later; 60 minutes can also work for a partial session. Exact options will follow at launch.
seoDeepTissue.faq3A: Not yet. Customer bookings are not open. We are first recruiting founding deep-tissue therapists in Utrecht.
